# Generated by tools/build_transformations.py. Character scope.
ac_knows_transformation_trigger = { OR = { has_trait = ac_tf_limitbreaker has_trait = ac_tf_reaper has_trait = ac_tf_godhand has_trait = ac_tf_soul_domain has_trait = ac_tf_malocchio has_trait = ac_tf_titan has_trait = ac_tf_asura } }
ac_transformation_ready_trigger = {
	has_trait = ac_cultivator
	has_trait = ac_immortal_core
	ac_aura_pressure_value >= 1500
}
ac_can_learn_tf_limitbreaker_trigger = {
	ac_transformation_ready_trigger = yes
	NOT = { has_trait = ac_tf_limitbreaker }
	ac_core_power_rating >= 3
	ac_core_fortitude_rating >= 3
	ac_core_agility_rating >= 3
	ac_core_soul_rating >= 3
}
ac_can_learn_tf_reaper_trigger = {
	ac_transformation_ready_trigger = yes
	NOT = { has_trait = ac_tf_reaper }
	has_trait = ac_style_akakiru
}
ac_can_learn_tf_godhand_trigger = {
	ac_transformation_ready_trigger = yes
	NOT = { has_trait = ac_tf_godhand }
	has_trait = ac_style_aoyusumu
}
ac_can_learn_tf_soul_domain_trigger = {
	ac_transformation_ready_trigger = yes
	NOT = { has_trait = ac_tf_soul_domain }
	has_trait = ac_style_kiihakai
}
ac_can_learn_tf_malocchio_trigger = {
	ac_transformation_ready_trigger = yes
	NOT = { has_trait = ac_tf_malocchio }
	has_trait = ac_style_kurokonton
}
ac_can_learn_tf_titan_trigger = {
	ac_transformation_ready_trigger = yes
	NOT = { has_trait = ac_tf_titan }
	has_trait = ac_style_midorikatai
	NOT = { has_trait = ac_tf_asura }
}
ac_can_learn_tf_asura_trigger = {
	ac_transformation_ready_trigger = yes
	NOT = { has_trait = ac_tf_asura }
	has_trait = ac_style_midorikatai
	NOT = { has_trait = ac_tf_titan }
}
ac_can_learn_any_transformation_trigger = {
	OR = {
		ac_can_learn_tf_limitbreaker_trigger = yes
		ac_can_learn_tf_reaper_trigger = yes
		ac_can_learn_tf_godhand_trigger = yes
		ac_can_learn_tf_soul_domain_trigger = yes
		ac_can_learn_tf_malocchio_trigger = yes
		ac_can_learn_tf_titan_trigger = yes
		ac_can_learn_tf_asura_trigger = yes
	}
}
# Can scope:actor learn a form this character knows?
ac_can_teach_transformation_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = { has_trait = ac_tf_limitbreaker scope:actor = { ac_can_learn_tf_limitbreaker_trigger = yes } }
		AND = { has_trait = ac_tf_reaper scope:actor = { ac_can_learn_tf_reaper_trigger = yes } }
		AND = { has_trait = ac_tf_godhand scope:actor = { ac_can_learn_tf_godhand_trigger = yes } }
		AND = { has_trait = ac_tf_soul_domain scope:actor = { ac_can_learn_tf_soul_domain_trigger = yes } }
		AND = { has_trait = ac_tf_malocchio scope:actor = { ac_can_learn_tf_malocchio_trigger = yes } }
		AND = { has_trait = ac_tf_titan scope:actor = { ac_can_learn_tf_titan_trigger = yes } }
		AND = { has_trait = ac_tf_asura scope:actor = { ac_can_learn_tf_asura_trigger = yes } }
	}
}
# Fighter scope, in a Clash of Auras.
ac_duel_can_transform_trigger = {
	NOT = { has_variable = ac_duel_tf }
	OR = { has_trait = ac_tf_limitbreaker has_trait = ac_tf_reaper has_trait = ac_tf_godhand has_trait = ac_tf_soul_domain has_trait = ac_tf_malocchio has_trait = ac_tf_titan has_trait = ac_tf_asura }
	ac_chi_available >= 1
}
